title: Aptitude Quiz
description: Test your aptitude skills with this quiz covering logical reasoning, mathematics, and general knowledge.

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 45 and their difference is 9. Find the larger number.
A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net percentage change?
The average of 8 numbers is 25. If one number is removed, the average becomes 24. What is the removed number?
A shopkeeper marks an item 25% above cost price and gives a discount of 10%. What is his profit percentage?
A train running at 72 km/h crosses a pole in 15 seconds. What is the length of the train?
A can complete a work in 12 days. B can complete the same work in 18 days. In how many days can they complete it together?
Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?
Find the missing term: B, E, J, Q, ?
A father is three times as old as his son. After 10 years, he will be twice as old. What is the son's present age?
